effects.name: junit-report-read
effects.source: the JUnit XML report collected at the path Vouch supplied to the evidence command, inside Vouch's private temporary directory (its writer is not observed), read without following a symlink and bounded by the store's artifact limit
effects.capture: each test case's classname::name ID and its outcome (failed, error, skipped, passed); the raw XML is not kept

effects.name: private-report-directory
effects.system: the local filesystem under Python's tempfile directory
effects.detail: record-evidence --junit-report creates a new private 0700 directory just before running the command, passes a report path inside it through the {junit} token, and removes the directory after the command exits, whether or not the recording succeeds

effects.name: test-report-store-write
effects.detail: a recording with a report writes a content-addressed test-report object and a format-3 evidence record naming it, and a merge that brings in format-3 records copies their test-report objects; a Vouch release older than this one cannot read or replay a format-3 record (a declared store action, D-31 note); recordings without a report write format-2 records byte-for-byte as before
